subject: Media Literacy
title: Source Bias: Who Gets Quoted
description: One-minute skill: Source Bias: Who Gets Quoted.

hook.text: A story about housing policy quotes three economists and zero tenants. The experts spoke. The affected didn't.

buildup.text: Source bias occurs when certain voices are consistently included while others are systematically excluded.

discovery.text: Studies show news disproportionately quotes men, wealthy people, officials, and people from dominant groups.

twist.text: The choice of who to quote shapes the story's conclusion. Different sources would tell a different story.

climax.text: When reading news, ask: whose voice is here, and whose is missing? The absent voice might change everything.

punchline.text: Who gets quoted decides what the story means.

quiz.question: What is source bias in media?
options: Consistently including certain voices while excluding others
